:::note[このページについて]
[s1000d-reader-mcp](/s1000d-stack/ja/mcp/reader-mcp/) 0.16.0 の `tools/list` の応答から生成したページです。設定のしかたと応答の読み方は、s1000d-reader-mcp のページにあります。
:::

## 概要

パブリケーションモジュールを目次として読みます。`pmEntry` の木と、各 `dmRef` / `pmRef` の解決先（ファイル・題名・版）

## `tools/list` が返す説明

LLM が受け取る説明の原文（英語）です。

> Read a publication module (PMC) as a table of contents: the pmEntry tree with titles, and for each dmRef/pmRef the resolved target (file, techName/infoName, issue) from the CSDB. Also returns the PM identification and a verification status.

## 引数

`inputSchema` の内容です。入れ子の引数は `親.子`、配列の要素は `親[].子` と書いています。説明は原文（英語）です。

| 名前 | 型 | 必須 | 値の制約 | 説明 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | `string` |  |  | File path of the document. |
| `xml` | `string` |  |  | The document as an XML string (alternative to path; max 5 MB). |
| `pmc` | `string` |  |  | PMC to read from the CSDB (e.g. "S1000DBIKE-B6865-EPWG1-00"; "PMC-" prefix optional). Alternative to path/xml. |
| `csdbDirs` | `array<string>` |  |  | CSDB folders to search for data modules by DMC, referenced objects, ACT/CCT/PCT and BREX (default: S1000D_CSDB_DIR / the config file). When given, these folders replace S1000D_CSDB_DIR and the csdbDirs of the config file (they are not added to them); folders that do not exist are skipped and reported in _notes. |
| `verify` | `string` |  | `schema` / `full` / `none`、既定値 `"schema"` | How much to verify before reading: "schema" (default) runs XSD validation only; "full" also checks BREX along the brexDmRef chain and resolves references; "none" skips verification (reported as not-run). |
